correctness.rationale: All 7776 partial maps of one binary letter on five labeled states are generated. Exactly 1569 total maps satisfy the one-cluster functional-graph condition. Exhausting every proper ordered pair with at least one such letter gives 14,594,838 candidates. Forward breadth-first search from the full state set and an independently implemented reverse multi-source breadth-first search from the five singletons agree for every candidate. The exact histogram has maximum 13 with 1200 labeled extremizers; canonicalization under every state permutation and both letter orders gives five classes of size 240.

value.rationale: The one-cluster condition is the central structural restriction of the direct source, while five-state proper binary PFAs are already completely known in the unrestricted class to reach length 15. Determining that the one-cluster subclass stops sharply at 13 and has exactly five equality classes quantifies the effect of that structural restriction at a natural small-state boundary and gives a complete, reproducible extremal classification rather than a routine witness.
